trust_decision.summary: Whether token text taken from the file being scanned may be run through eval() - and what happens when that eval throws - is decided once, inside AbstractArrayDeclarationSniff::getActualArrayKey(): a token whitelist plus a callback bail-out guard the eval, and the screened commit only adds a Throwable/Exception catch there so a throwing key expression yields 'key unknown'.

landing_point.why: The only eval() in the repository and the sink named by the advisory; a reader who only saw 'RCE via eval() in getActualArrayKey()' opens this function and lands on this line.

fix_sites.entry_point: PHPCSUtils\AbstractSniffs\AbstractArrayDeclarationSniff::getActualArrayKey() - public helper called by concrete sniffs (referenced as an optional helper at line 337); not called anywhere inside the library
fix_sites.module_kind: library public API / abstract-sniff helper (no HTTP route, CLI command or framework handler)

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Valid literal keys must still be evaluated and normalised: null -> '', booleans -> int, floats -> int, numeric strings such as '1' -> int while '01' stays a string. A fix that returns void for anything not trivially single-token, or that removes the eval, breaks this documented resolution.

O6_input_shapes: literal arithmetic key that throws DivisionByZeroError (1/0)
syntactically incomplete key expression that throws ParseError ((100 - ))
any otherwise-accepted literal expression whose eval() raises a catchable throwable

O8b_injection_room.sibling: getActualArrayValue(): a value-side twin of getActualArrayKey() that eval()s literal token text for the value part of an array item.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: processValue() already receives the value token range and the class already owns a whitelist/eval/catch helper for the key side; a maintainer adding constant-value checks for sniffs would naturally copy the key helper and with it the same eval mechanism.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Arrays::getLiteralKeyValue() utility that resolves a literal key/expression so code outside AbstractArrayDeclarationSniff can use it.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Arrays already owns double-arrow discovery; moving the resolution logic down into the Utils layer is a plausible refactor and would duplicate the eval-based resolver at distance from the class the report points at.

O9_family: CWE-95 code injection via eval() of token text from the scanned file; the screened hunk itself only converts an uncaught throwable into a void return

O10_build.toolchain: Composer; requires PHP >=5.4, squizlabs/php_codesniffer ^3.13.5 || ^4.0.1, dealerdirect/phpcodesniffer-composer-installer; dev deps ext-filter, phpcsstandards/phpcsdevcs, php-parallel-lint, yoast/phpunit-polyfills; tests run via 'composer test' (PHPUnit)
O10_build.project_tests: PHPUnit suite under Tests/; for this area Tests/AbstractSniffs/AbstractArrayDeclaration/GetActualArrayKeyTest.php driven by fixture Tests/AbstractSniffs/AbstractArrayDeclaration/GetActualArrayKeyTest.inc (plus AbstractArrayDeclarationSniffTest.php)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Delete the eval() or bail out for any multi-token/arithmetic key, which breaks the documented literal-key resolution ('1' -> 1, null -> '', true -> 1, 1.5 -> 1) asserted by the existing tests.
